mapper.insert: insert into tbl_get_together(place_id, together_title, together_content, together_purpose, together_area, together_max_member, together_start_date, together_end_date) values (#{placeId}, #{togetherTitle}, #{togetherContent}, #{togetherPurpose}::together_purpose, #{togetherArea}::together_area, #{togetherMaxMember}, now(), now() + interval '2 hours')
mapper.select: select id, place_id, together_title, together_content, together_purpose, together_area, together_max_member, together_start_date, together_end_date, together_status, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_get_together where id = #{id}

select id, place_id, together_title, together_content, together_purpose, together_area, together_max_member, together_start_date, together_end_date, together_status, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_get_together order by id desc
select member_id from tbl_together_member where together_id = #{id} and together_role = 'HOST'
mapper.update: update tbl_get_together set together_title = #{togetherTitle}, together_content = #{togetherContent}, together_max_member = #{togetherMaxMember}, together_area = #{togetherArea}::together_area, together_purpose = #{togetherPurpose}::together_purpose, updated_datetime = now() where id = #{id}

update tbl_get_together set together_status = 'ENDED', together_end_date = now() where together_status in ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') and now() - interval '2 hours' > together_start_date and id not in (select together_id from tbl_chat where id in (select chat_id from tbl_chat_message where created_datetime > now() - interval '2 hours'))
